response.sql: WITH media_type_rates AS (SELECT mt.Name, SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) as rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name), mean_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) as avg_rate FROM media_type_rates) SELECT mtr.Name, mtr.rate, mtr.rate / mr.avg_rate as rate_divided_by_mean FROM media_type_rates mtr CROSS JOIN mean_rate mr
